tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa las rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi snyan brgyud zab don rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rnal 'byor yan lag drug la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las// sngon 'gro thun mong skor dang*/ dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs gnyis yod pa la/ sngon 'gro dang bskyed rim gyi skor rnams gzhan du shes par bya zhing*/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi sbyor ba yan lag drug po 'di/ rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa/ mdo rgyud du ma las gsal bar gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug du mas rdo rje'i tshig tu bstan pa 'di lta ste/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod// ces dang*/ dpal kyai rdo rje brtag pa dang po'i le'u brgyad pa las/ dang po nag po rab tu bsgom// gnyis pa dmar po rnam par bsgom// gsum pa la ni ser po bsgom// bzhi pa ljang khu de bzhin no// lnga pa kha dog sngon po dang*// drug pa dkar po'i lus can no// yan lag drug sgom rnal 'byor pas// dga' bral mtha' 'ang de bzhin no// zhes dang*/ 'khor lo sdom par/ sngags pa ba dang bsam gtan dang*// bde ba yis ni 'grub par 'gyur// zhes pa'i don ni/ sngags bzlas pa ni srog rtsol yin la/ de'i rjes su 'dzin pa shugs bstan/ de bzhin du bsam gtan dngos su bstan la/ de'i sngon du sor sdud las shugs bstan/ bde ba zhes pa ting nge 'dzin gyi don yin la/ de'i sngon du rjes su dran pa shugs bstan no// de bzhin du bde mchog sdom 'byung dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo shin tu mang bar bstan pa yin te/ rgya 'grel dri ma med pa las/ gang gi mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas mi shes pa des/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mi shes/ gang gis mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mi shes pa de/ 'khor ba ste/ zhes pa'i don ni/ nā ro paṇa chen gyis/

de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// ye shes sku ni khyod la 'dud// zhes pa'i bar gyis sbyor ba yan lag drug po bsgom tshul yang*/ de'i ngo sprod 'chad pa la/ rgyal ba'i sras po man lung pas/ gtsug tor chen po rmad byung gtsug /zhes pa nas/ rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che// zhes pa'i bar gyis/ sbyor ba yan lag drug po sgom tshul bstan pa yin gsungs/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ nges don mthar thug pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug po hril gyis bsdu na/ thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i khrid yig rnam pa gsum du 'dus pa yin te/ de'i tshul yang*/ sor sdud bsam gtan sku rdo rje'i bsnyen pa'i yan lag sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor thog mar dge ba'i khrid yig sha ba ris bi ma la tsan+d+ra la gsungs pa ltar bris/ srog rtsol 'dzin grub pa'i yan lag gsung rdo rje'i khrid yig paṇa chen shākya shrīs sa skya paṇa chen la gsungs pa ltar bris/ rjes su dran pa grub pa'i yan lag thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang*/ ting nge 'dzin grub pa chen po'i yan lag thugs kyi ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ rgyud dang 'grel pa nas ji ltar byung ba ltar bris/ 'di yi don yang*/ mtshan brjod las/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// zhes pa dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ sgrub pa yis ni dam tshig dang*// de bzhin nye bar bsnyen pa dang*// sgrub pa don gyi dam tshig dang*// sgrub pa chen po dag dang bzhi// zhes gsungs so// sbyor ba yan lag drug gi drang nges ni/ 'bras bu'i gnas skabs su/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ bde stong gnyis su med pa dus kyi 'khor lo de thob par byed pa'i rgyu la/ yan lag drug tu nges pa yin te/ de yang sku ma grub pa 'grub par byed pa sor sdud/ de brtan par byed pa bsam gtan/ gsung ma grub pa 'grub par byed pa srog rtsol/ de brtan par byed pa 'dzin pa/ thugs ma grub pa 'grub par byed pa rjes dran/

de brtan par byed pa ting nge 'dzin yin gsungs/ de yang so sor sdud pa 'chad par byed pa la/ chos kyi rje phyogs pa'i khrid yig las/ kun la drug drug shes byas te// zhes pa dang mthun par/ sor sdud kyi mtshan don la sogs drug tu gsungs pa ni/ 'dir sor sdud kyi ngo bo/ sor sdud kyi dbye ba/ sor sdud kyi bogs 'don/ sgom 'phro la shi ba dang*/ rnal 'byor goms stobs kyi 'jug pa/ sor sdud sgom pa'i 'bras bu'o// sor sdud kyi ngo bo ni/ dbang po lnga po yul lnga'i rjes su mi 'brangs par/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtse gcig tu 'jog pa yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ yul dang yul can bcu po rnams// rang gi 'jug gnas thams cad la// 'dod pa so sor sdud pa'i phyir// so sor sdud pa zhes brjod do// zhes dang*/ yang 'grel pa dri med las/ so sor sdud pa phyag rgya che// nam mkha' stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes dang*/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas kyang*/ thugs kyi rdo rje nam mkhar bzhag /yul dang yul can 'brel ba bcad// stong gzugs mngon du gyur pa yi// so sor sdud pa bsgom par shog /ces dang*/ kun mkhyen chen pos kyang*/ yid rnam rtog 'gyu ba so sor bcad// ces dang*/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las kyang*/ 'dir dbang po lnga yul lnga la 'jug pa med par/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu 'jug par byed do// zhes gsungs so// sor sdud kyi dbye ba ni/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis yod pa yin te/ mdo las/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ gnas brtan rab 'byor/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa de/ gang la rnal 'byor du byed/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau'u shi ka gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa de ni/ nam mkha' la rnal 'byor du byed do zhes pas mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa de ni/

bla gab med pa la rnal 'byor du byed do zhes pas/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor bstan to// spyir sor sdud sgom pa'i dus ni/ sna bug g.yas nas rlung rgyu ba'i skabs yin te/ dus 'khor las/ sa ni chu la 'jug ste chu ni 'bar byed las te gtsang bar byed pa rlung la'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar so sor bsdud pa bsgom pa'i rtags ni/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyir bsam gtan sgom pa'i gnas ni/ nyin mo mi la sogs pa'i sgra med pa/ mtshan mo mi ma yin la sogs pa'i sgra med pa zhig dgos te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ tshegs chung ba dang gnas bzang dang*// bsam bzang pa dang grogs bzang dang*// rnal 'byor bde ba'i yo byad ldan// zhes pa rnams spyir gnas bstan la/ bye brag gi gnas ni/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i mun khang ni/ sgo 'khyud rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ bug pa rta rnga shong ba tsam yang med pa/ 'og sa rlangs la sogs pa med cing*/ blos dkar phyi rub la nang yangs pa/ phyi la kha dog nag po byugs pa/ steng du bug pa yod pa/ de lta bu'i gnas der/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom tshul ni/ lus gnad sngar dang 'dra/ bsgom tshul ni/ spyi bye brag gnyis/ spyir ni chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yin la/ de dang mthun par da ltar gyi shes pa 'di yang*/ spros pa thams cad dang bral bar 'jog dgos pa yin te/ jo bo rjes/ chos dbyings spros dang bral ba la// shes pa'ang spros dang bral bar bzhag /ces pa'i don no// bye brag gi sgom tshul ni/ lus ngag yid gsum mi g.yo bar rtse gcig tu 'jog pa dang*/ lta stangs cung zhig bstod de sems gang la yang mi g.yo bar rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/ spre'u sgo gcig pa lta bu dang*/ lta stangs snga ma dang 'dra ba yin pa la/ sems dmigs pa rtse gcig tu 'jog pa spun gsum gyi bar pa lta bu dang*/ yang lta stangs cung zhig glod la/ rnga mong bcings grol lta bu'i man ngag dang bzhi'o// lus ngag yid gsum mi g.yo bar rtse gcig tu 'jog pa ni/

lus gnad lta stangs snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ lus mi g.yo ba lha khang nang gi lder tsho 'jim sku lta bu/ ngag mi g.yo ba yang lha khang nang gi lder tsho lta bu/ sems mi g.yo ba lha khang nang gi lder tsho lta bur mdun gyi nam mkha'i thad du/ mig mi g.yo bar rtse gcig tu 'jog pa yin te/ sha ba ri'i gzhung chung las/ mi g.yo ba ni gsum ldan gyis// dhū tir rlung bcu tshud 'gyur zhing*// phyi nang rtog 'gags rtags 'byung ste// so sor sdud pa'i yan lag go// zhes dang*/ til+li pa'i zhal nas/ blo dman skye bo don la mi gnas na// rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcud la bor// lta stangs dang ni sems 'dzin du ma yis// rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar la bcun// zhes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma las/ blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi rtogs// byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rtogs// byar med gnyug ma'i don de rtogs 'dod na// sems nyid rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog /rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dwangs su chug /dgag sgrub med na phyag rgya chen po yin// de la goms zhing 'dris na bla med byang chub 'thob// ces dang*/ klong sde las/ mdun gyi mkha' de nyid la// dbang po gtad de cog bzhag na// gsal la mi rtog ye shes te// da lta nyid du 'char bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dpung bzang las/ sna rtser blta zhing rnam par rtog pa spong*// nam zhig bskyod kyang rnam par mi g.yo ba// de tshe dmigs la gnas pa grub pa yin// de tshe yid la dga' ba skye 'gyur zhing*// dga' bas lus khyab shin tu sbyangs pa 'thob// ces dang*/ sa ra has kyang*/ mang du smras pas ci zhig bya// chos kyi tshad ni 'di yis chog /mig phyed gyen du lta ba dang*// mthong ba brtan pa nyid kyis shes// zhes dang*/ bde mchog bstod 'grel las/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs la// nyi ma gcig tu nges par brtag /de tshe rtags 'di ma byung na// de ni nga yi rdzun tshig yin// zhes dang*/

dus 'khor las/ nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems kyi mig mi 'dzum par rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yi/ zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ sna tshogs rnam rtog bral zhing mi bsam pa// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag ni yin nam bsam// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mtha' dag 'di las 'byung*// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ yid dmigs rlung gsum nam mkha' la// rnal 'byor mkhas pas legs sbyar nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan 'char// kun mkhyen kun gyi gsung yin no// zhes dang*/ de thams cad kyi don hril gyis dril na/ mdun gyi nam mkha' de nyid la/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i sgo nas/ 'di ni zhi gnas sgrub pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa'o// de la brten nas lhag mthong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyang myur du skye bar 'gyur la/ sngar bstan pa ltar/ zhi gnas mtshan nyid tshang ba rgyud la ma skyes na/ lhag mthong yang gnad la mi skye te/ spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gi// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms pa shes byas te// thog mar zhig gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin// zhes dang*/ yang nyid las/ chos kyi ming ni sdom zhes bya// zhi gnas lam du shes par bya// lhag mthong ming ni de yi don// rnam par gcod pa shes par bya// zhes pa'i don rnams ni/ zhi gnas kyi dmigs rten/ dpe rde'u shing bu sogs dpag tu med pa zhig yod na'ang*/ 'dir mdun gyi nam mkha' de nyid la/ yid mig rlung gsum po de rtse gcig tu 'jog pa gnad dam pa'o// de'i ngang nas gnas 'gyu gnyis ngo bo gcig mi gcig kyang brtags la/ ngo bo gcig na/ gnas dus mi gnas la/ ngo bo mi gcig na/ gnas pa las gzhan du gyur pa'i 'gyu ba de ga na 'dug ces/

rang rang gi sems la blta rtog bcug nas/ shes par byed de/ de'i tshul yang*/ snga ma ni rang lugs yin la/ phyi ma ni gzhan lugs so// de yang gnas pa de'i ngos nas/ rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phros kyang gnas pa de las gzhan du gyur pa med pas/ des na 'gyu bas gnas pa'i go chod pa'i gnad rig par bya'o// zhes pa 'di spyir bka' brgyud rin po che'i man ngag mthar thug pa yin la/ ka bzhi ba nam mkha' dbang phyug gi dgongs pa bzhin bkod pa yin/ 'dis mtshon nas rnam rtog kyang chos sku yin min go nus/ sems rig gang la'ang mi g.yo ba rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/ spre'u sgo gcig pa lta bu'i man ngag ni/ dper na spre'u de/ sgo brgyad bkag nas sgo gcig phye ba lta bu'i dpe dang mtshungs pa lus gnad snga ma ltar la/ blta stangs yar bstod nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'jog lugs snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ mdo las steng du rgyu zhing gcig por 'gro// lus med dbang po'i phugs na gnas// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// sems dmigs pa rtse gcig tu 'jog pa spun gsum gyi bar ma lta bu'i man ngag ni/ lus gnad blta stangs gong dang 'dra la/ khyad par ni sems 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyod pa 'char ka lta bu'o// ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu ba zla ba grags pa lta bu'o// da lta ba yid la mi byed pa/ 'dod byed ma'i gtam rgyud bzhin du byas nas/ sems da ltar shes pa 'dzin med du 'jog pa yin te/ nā ro pa'i dbang mdor bstan las/ dang po thog mtha' las grol zhing*// bar pa tsam la yang dag gnas// gang zhig der gnas 'dor ba yi// de yi snang ba bcu bdag nyid// ces dang*/ yang de nyid las/ sngar rjes mi gcod sngon mi bsu// da lta 'dzin med rang sar gzhag /ces dang*/ mdo brgyad stong pa las kyang*/ 'das pa'i sems kyang dmigs su med/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems kyang dmigs su med/ da ltar byung ba'i sems kyang dmigs su med ces dang*/

'bum las kyang*/ 'das pa'i sems la 'das pa'i sems mi sbyor mi 'byed/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems la ma 'ongs pa'i sems mi sbyor mi 'byed/ da ltar byung ba'i sems la da ltar byung ba'i sems mi sbyor mi 'byed// ces dang mtshan brjod las/ dus gsum dus med rtogs pa po// zhes dang*/ sa ra ha'i zhal nas kyang*/ sngar rjes mi dpyod 'das pa'i 'du shes dor// phyis sngon mi bsu ma 'ongs rnam rtog spongs// da lta ba la brtsi bgrang smos ci dgos// 'di ni phyag rgya chen po'i lam yin no// zhes pa rnams kyi da ltar gyi shes pa gang la'ang mtshon pa med pa/ spun gsum gyi bar pa lta bu'i mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ yid dmigs rlung gsum rtse gcig tu 'jog ces pa'i don du 'dug bzhi pa rnga mong bcings grol gyi man ngag ni/ blta stangs snga ma gnyis kyi sems cung 'jur drags na/ blta stangs cung zhig smad/ mdun gyi thad kyi nam mkha' de nyid la/ dran pas sems rtse gcig tu 'jog par byed/ lus gnad snga ma dang 'dra bar byed dgos pa yin te/ phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma las/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra// chos rnams ma lus de ru ma 'dus med// bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces dang*/ yang de nyid las/ lus ni snying po med de snyug stong 'dra// sems ni nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsam las 'das// des na btang bzhag med par glod la zhog /ces dang*/ do ha las/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni// glod na grol bar the tshom med// bram ze skud pa 'khel ba bzhin// so ma ma bcos lhug par zhog /rnal 'byor shes pa glod na bde// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ brtag na mi sdod phyogs bcur rgyug /glod na mi g.yo brtan par gnas// bdag gi go ldog rnga mong thong*// ngas ni de las ma rtogs so// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las// sems kyi rnga mong yan du chug

/de nyid bdag po la dris shig /ces dang*/ yang de nyid las/ gzings la 'phur ba'i bya rog rnams// bskor zhing bskor zhing slar yang de ru 'bab// ces dang*/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis kyang*/ ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin// ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa bla ma'i man ngag yin// ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa kho bo'i dam bca' yin// ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang du 'jog snying 'dod// ces dang*/ yang ma gcig gis kyang*/ lhod kyis glod la hril gyis sgrims// sgom pa'i gnad cig de na 'dug /ces dang*/ phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma las/ sgom rgyu rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig mi ster ba// zhes pa la sogs pa lugs mang po 'dug na'ang*/ yi ge mang du dogs nas ma bris/ sor sdud kyi dmigs pa de thams cad bsdus na/ lta stangs snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i thad du/ yid dmigs rlung gsum po de/ sbrang ma gar spyin la 'byar ba'am/ spang skam po la phur pa btab pa bzhin du/ dran pas rtse gcig tu 'jog par byed pa yin la/ de'i ngang nas shes pa cung bying na/ spre'u sgo gcig pa dang*/ spun gsum gyi bar ma lta bus gzengs bstod/ yang de'i ngang nas shes pa rgod thal na/ rnga mong bcings grol dang*/ mi g.yo ba gsum ldan gyi dmigs pas/ sems khong glod nas blta stangs cung zhig smad nas 'jog par byed do// 'di ni bying rgod sel ba'i gegs sel yin te/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i bshags bstod las/ brtson pa ches na rgod pa skye 'gyur zhing*// zhum pa las ni bying ba skye bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i don du 'dug sor sdud kyi nyin mtshan gnyis las/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor snga bar 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ snang ba sdud sla ba yin gsungs/ de ltar sor sdud kyi dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe na/ stong gzugs dpag tu med pa zhig 'char ba mdo rgyud du ma las gsungs te/

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dang po du ba lta bu te/ gnyis pa mig rgyu lta bu'o// gsum pa mkha' nang lta bu ste// bzhi pa mar me lta bu'o// lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni// sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ dang po nag po rab tu bsgom// zhes sogs dang*/ rdo rje gur las kyang*/ dang po sprin gyis rnam pas te// gnyis pa du ba lta bu ste// gsum pa mkha' nang mar mes te// bzhi pa mar mes nye 'bar ba// lnga pa sprin med nam mkha' 'o// zhes dang*/ mtshan brjod las/ sna tshogs gzugs can yid las skyes// gzugs rnams ma lus snang ba'i dpal// gzugs brnyan ma lus 'chang ba po// zhes dang*/ dpal dus 'khor las/ mig rgyu du ba mkha' nang dang*// sgron me 'bar ba zla nyi ma// bun chen cha shas thig le che// sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dang*/ yang dus 'khor las/ nam mkha' las ni du ba smig rgyu mkha' nang dang ni mar me 'bar ba'o// zhes dang*/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ phyag rgya sgyu ma'i rjes su mthun pa'i yid dang nam mkha' la ni me long dag la gzugs bzhin te// 'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed cing dri med glog ltar 'od zer du ma 'phro bar byed// phyi dang nang ni dbyer med snang ba tsam ste nam mkha' la ni gnas pa yi// sems la sems kyi rang bzhin gyis 'khyud gang zhig 'gro ba du ma'i gzugs can de ni gcig pu ste// zhes dang*/ phag mo dpyal lugs las/ dang po ri dwags sred zhi'i rnam pas te// mtshan ma gnyis pa du ba lta bu ste// gsum pa srin bu me khyer lta bu ste// bzhi pa mar me 'bar ba lta bu'o// mtshan ma lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni// sprin med nam mkha' lta bus te// mtshan ma 'di dag mthong bar gyur pa na// thams cad mkhyen pa dngos grub nye bar gyur pa yin// zhes dang*/ dpa' bo chen po sa ra has kyang*/ rnam rtog snang ba 'di ni gad mor che// mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu yi// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// de tshe mgon po nga nyid 'khrul pa zad// da ni su la'ang dri bar mi bya'o// zhes dang*/

yang de nyid las rmad byung nam mkha'i dkyil du sbu bu gu// sna tshogs me tog shar ro sbu bu gu// me tog 'di ni kha dog sna lngar ldan// me tog 'di ni stong nyid dgon par skye// rin chen rin thang med pa'i me tog longs// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ nam mkha'i sbrum ma dag las skye ba mthong*// zhes dang*/ brgyad stong pa las/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ 'phags pa rab 'byor/ me tog 'di dag ni shing gel pa dang*/ 'khri shing las gyur pa ma yin te/ bdag sngon chad sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i nang du yod pa'i dus na yang ma mthong ngo*// rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau'u shi ka gang ma skyes pa de ni me tog ma yin te/ me tog de dag ni yid las byung ba yin no// zhes dang*/ nā ro paṇa chen gyis/ dbang mdor bstan du lung drangs pa las/ me tog sna lngar shar zhing de ru thim// shin+ta rang nyid dpang bzhag rang nyid rgod// shin+tas smras pa de tshe 'khrul pa zhig /dga' dang snying rje ḍā ma ru yi sgra// 'phags pa lha yi dmigs pa med la gsal// zhes dang*/ rje mar pas kyang*/ rje nā ro dang me tris byin rlabs pa'i// chos phyag rgya che la ngo sprod byas// don gnyug ma sems kyi ngo bo mthong*// gzhi chos nyid spros dang bral bar rtogs// zhes dang*/ rje dwags po'i zhal nas/ sna tshogs kyi snang ba dkar dmar 'di// chos sku yin pa da gzod shes// zhes dang*/ rje mi las kyang*/ 'khor ba ma mthong myang 'das mthong*// rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong*// chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong*// zhes dang*/ yang rgyud las/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// gar mkhan dag dang ri mo bzang 'drar ston// gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid// gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i brdar mdzad do// ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'bum dang*/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal dang*/ nyi khri dang*/ zla ba sgron me dang*/ phal chen gyi nor bzang gi rtogs brjod dang*/

byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod dang*/ snying po mdo lnga mdo bcu dang*/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla'i nang du bzhugs pa sogs mang du 'dug kyang brir ma lang*/ yang rgyud bla'i nang nas/ 'byung med gzugs la blta dang gtam bzang dang*// gtsang ma nyan dang bde gshegs tshul khrims dang*// dri bzang snom dang 'phags can dam chos ro// myong dang ting 'dzin rig myong nyams myong dang*// rang gi ngo bo nyid kyi zab pa'i tshul/ rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur zhib mor bsam pa na// don dam ston mdzad bde gshegs snying po ni// nam mkha' bzhin du rgyu mtshan rnams dang bral// zhes dang*/ de lta bu'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po de/ mngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs dam pa ni/ lus gnad dam por bcings pas ro rkyang gi rlung gnyis dbu ma'i nang du tshud pa la brten nas mthong ba yin te/ dus 'khor las/ ji ltar me ni shing la rtag gnas kyang*// bcad kyang dbye bas mthong bar mi 'gyur bas// gtsub shing gtsub stan lag pas bsrubs pa las// de las yod pa yang ni mthong bar 'gyur// de bzhin sems kyi 'od gsal rnam rtog gi// thabs rnams kyis ni mthong bar mi 'gyur te// de nyid du ni 'dir yang ma dag dang*// ro ma gcig tu sbyor bas mthong bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ 'grel pa dri med las kyang*/ thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor bas// e waṃ yi ge de la 'dud// ces gsungs pa ltar/ lus gnad dang lta stangs ma 'chug pa gal che'o// nyin mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus gnad lta stangs snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ khyad par sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la/ rgya mi che bar 'bur tshugs su blta bar byed pa yin te/ dus 'khor las/ nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag la rnal 'byor pa yi bsgrad pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ste re kha nag po dus kyi rtsa la mthong gi bar du'o// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ snga dro nyi mar rgyab phyogs zhing*// phyi dro yang ni de bzhin te/

nyin gung mig la gnod phyir spang*// zhes dang*/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa la brten te/ mtshan brjod las kyang*/ nyin rtags lnga bstan pa yin te/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba// shes rab ye shes me 'od che// 'od chen rnam par snang ba che// ye shes snang ba lam me ba// 'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron// gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba// sngags mchog sngags bdag rigs sngags rgyal// zhes pas/ gsal bar bstan pa yin zhing*/ 'di yi don go sla/ gong du bshad pas/ rdzogs rim mthar thug pa rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po de/ dpyad sgom dang*/ med dang dgag gi stong nyid dang*/ lta bas gtan la phab pa'i blos byas kyis mi rtogs te/ bram chen po sa ra has/ gcig dang du mas rnam par dpyad pa yi// gsal ba spangs nas stong pa nyid du 'jug /mthong zhing mthong nas srid par 'gro ba yi// 'di las snying rje ba ni su zhig yod// ces dang*/ yang de nyid las/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*/ des kyang lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ 'jal dpal zhal lung las/ phung po thams cad stong pa nyid// chu shing lta bur snying po med// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin// zhes dang*/ til+li pas kyang*/ sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang*// 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa'i sde snod sogs// rang rang lugs dang grub pa'i mtha' yis kyang*// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mi rtogs so// zhes dang*/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis kyang*/ dbu ma'i 'dod tshul gzhung gi tshul// de ni rtsod pa kun la rmongs// bskal pa'i yal gar bsgoms byas kyang*// sems kyi de nyid mthong ba min// zhes dang*/ yang jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ rtog bcas rtog pa med pa yis// shes pa gnyis kyi mi rtog pa// slob dpon chen po sba bya bzhed// ces dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis kyang*/

'gro mang phung po stong par ston byed kyang*// de ni bdag med ji ltar mi shes te// mi shes pa de gzhan gyis rgol ba na// khro bas zil gyis mnan nas tshig rtsub smra// zhes pa la sogs pa/ 'di'i don 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ chen po gsum gyi ma reg pa'i lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan bya ba 'di'i don du 'dug blos byas kyis mi rtogs par mdo rgyud/ grub thob gong ma'i gsung du 'dug tu na'ang brir ma lang*/ so sor sdud pa'i bogs 'don ni/ lus gnad sngar ltar la/ lto ba sgal tshigs la sbyar/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig mdun la sgril nas sdod pa yin te/ snyan brgyud las/ mtshan mo gsing med khyim du ni// byed pa lnga la bcing ba gnyis// bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya// zhes pas byed pa lnga ni/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga/ phyi rol gyi gzugs sgra dri ro la sogs pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi byed pas bcings nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' de nyid la hrig ger blta bar byed pa yin gsungs/ 'di yi don yang*/ yang de nyid las/ sor sor sdud pa spogs pa ni// byed bcings rab tu brtson par bya// 'bol ba'i stan la byed pa ni// gsus sbyar lce zlog mig gyen zlog /gtsug gtor bsgyur ba'i lta stangs so// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// sor sdud kyi 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis las/ gnas skabs ni/ me zhi bar gyur cig sngon la sogs pa med par gyur cig ces pa la sogs/ sor sdud sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ ngag bden pa'i tshig gi 'grub pa'o// de skad du'ang dus 'khor las/ so sor sdud pa sngags la sogs pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa la sogs pa'o// mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ spyir gzhi'i dus su/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i gzhi'i chos nyid dam/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ sbyang gzhi yin la/

glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang bya yin la/ sbyong byed lam ni thar lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ sbyor ba yan lag drug yin/ des sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ gzhi yi dus su sgrib bcas de bzhin nyid// lam gyi dus su sbyor ba yan lag drug /'bras bu'i dus su bral 'bras chos kyi sku// zhes pa'i don no// bye brag tu so sor sdud pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ gzhi yi dus kyi khams kyi dbang du byas na/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i ye shes kyi khams/ phung po dri ma dang bcas pa'i ye shes kyi phung po de gnyis la/ so sor sdud pa'i lam gyi dri ma sbyangs pa las/ 'bras bu'i skabs su/ dri ma dang bral ba'i khams gnyis po de rnam par snang mdzad du gnas 'gyur ba yin te/ rgyud las/ so sor sdud pa yang rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid de// zhes pa'o// de thams cad kyi sor sdud kyi don song*/ bsam gtan gyi ngo bo dang*/ bsam gtan gyi dbye ba dang*/ bsam gtan gyi bogs 'don dang*/ de'i 'bras bu'o// da bsam gtan gyi ngo bo ni/ sngar sor sdud kyi gnas skabs su rtags mngon du gyur pa de rnams la/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga/ yul lnga'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ rtags rnams la rtse gcig tu blta bar byed pa yin te/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ sgom pa sngar gyi stong gzugs la// goms phyir nam mkhar blta bar bya// goms pa brtan phyir bsam gtan no// zhes dang*/ dri med 'od las kyang*/ yul dang yul can bcu po rnams// sna tshogs gzugs la bsam gtan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// bsam gtan sgom pa'i dus ni/ sna bug g.yon nas rlung rgyu ba'i dus yin/ bsam gtan gyi dbye ba ni/ sngar gyi stong gzugs de nyid la/ bsam gtan gyi ngo bo yan lag lnga ldan du blta bar byed pa yin te/ dus 'khor las/

shes rab rtogs dpyod mi g.yo dga' ba rtse gcig sems pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ stong gzugs de nyid la/ shes rab de stong pa nyid kyi gzugs la blta bar byed pa'o// rtog pas stong gzugs rags pa 'byed pa'o// spyod pas stong gzugs de zhib tu so sor 'byed pa'o// mi g.yo dga' bas stong gzugs de mthong ba'i tshe/ lus sems la dga' bas khyab pa'o// rtse gcig sems pa ni/ stong gzugs de dang lus sems gnyis po chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur dbyer mi phyed par 'dres pa'o// 'di la bla ma kha cig yan lag lnga po la khrid lngar byed pa'ang 'dug bsam gtan gyi bogs 'don ni/ nyin par sgom tshul sna tshogs la bslab pa dang*/ mtshan mo gnyid kyi 'od gsal bzung ba'o// dang po nyin par bsgom tshul sna tshogs la bslab pa ni/ srog rtsol sgo ru 'od gsal 'dzin pa dang*/ dhū ti'i sgo ru 'od gsal 'dzin pa dang*/ snang ba'i sgo ru 'od gsal 'dzin pa dang gsum mo// srog rtsol sgo ru 'od gsal 'dzin tshul ni/ lus gnad sngar dang 'dra ba la/ sna rtse'i thad mdun gyi nam mkha' la sems rtse gcig tu 'jog pa yin te/ snying po rgyan las/ srog rtsol sgo ru 'od gsal bzung*// 'gyu ba rlung gi de nyid shes// rlung lnga'i kha dog mthong bar 'gyur// zhes pas/ zhi rgyas la sogs las rnams 'grub/ yang lus gnad snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ lte ba'i thad du lta stangs mi g.yo rtse gcig tu 'jog pa yin te/ yang de nyid las/ dhū ti'i sgo ru 'od gsal bzung*// rtog med sems kyi de nyid mthong*// rdo rje'i lus kyi de nyid shes// gsang sngags chos la mkhas par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yang lus gnad snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ lta stangs kyis stong gzugs smig rgyu sogs gang shar de/ rde'u shing bu sogs gang snang gi steng du sres nas sgom par byed pa yin te/ yang de nyid las/ snang ba'i sgo ru 'od gsal bzung*// phra ba'i 'od la brten nas ni// rags pa'i 'od ces ngo sprad pas// rtog med sems las srid 'das 'byung*// zhes pa'i don no// yang bsam gtan gyi nyin snang ni/

sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la/ nyi ma la rgyab phyogs pa'i ngos nas/ rang gi grib ma'i snying ga'i thad du sems rtse gcig tu blta/ de nas grib gzugs de rim pa bzhin du nam mkha' la blta bar byed/ des ni rang gi grib gzugs nam mkha' la mngon sum du shar nas 'ong*/ de'i tshe grib ma'i gzugs la bltas pas/ lus la na tsha dang grib la sogs pa yod med kyang shes/ de goms nas grib gzugs kyi nang du/ rtsa 'khor la sogs pa rtsa'i gnas tshul rnams gsal bor 'char gsungs/ de skad du'ang dus 'khor las/ nyi ma dag la rgyab kyis phyogs zhing rang gi grib ma dag gi nyi 'od dag la bltas pas rang gi yid kyi zhen pa'i ro nyams skyes bu du ba'i mdog can mthong bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i don no// mtshan mo zla 'od la grib gzugs brtags kyang rung gsungs/ mtshan mo'i gnyid 'od gsal du bzung lugs ni/ gzhogs g.yas phab/ lag pa g.yas kyi srin lag gi sna bug g.yas bkag g.yon pa'i brla'i steng du bzhag sngas cung mtho bar byed/ mig btsums pas mig 'bras grol nas mi rtog pa'i ngang la 'jog par byed de/ spyod 'jug las/ mgon po mya ngan 'das gzims ltar// 'dod pa'i phyogs su nyal bar byed// ces pa'i don no// thun mtshams su mnyam rjes sre bar byed pa ni/ dran pa brtan par byed de/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ dran pa yengs med ma shes na// mi sgom pa la bya thabs med// ces pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ brtson 'grus chen po'i go ba de// dran pa rgyun chad med pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don dang*/ ma gcig gis kyang*/ dran pa mkhas na sgom mkhas/ dran pa mi mkhas na sgom mi mkhas/ sgom dran pa'i rtsa na gda'// zhes dang*/ bshes spring las/ dbang phyug stobs bcu dran pa bde gshegs kyi// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam du thub pas gsungs// yang de nyid las/ dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pa'i lung rnams kyi don ni/

sems kyi ngo bo mi rtog pa la/ dran 'dzin gyi rtsi dang ma bral ba byas na/ sgom 'khor yug tu yod pa 'di ni gnad chen po 'dug 'chi ba 'od gsal 'dzin tshul gyi don ni/ rnal 'byor pa 'chi ba'i tshe/ sa chu la thim pa'i dus su/ phyi rtags su du ba lta bu/ nang rtags su ris mnan pa lta bu/ chu me la thim dus/ phyi rtags la kha sna nas chu yong zhing*/ nang rtags la smig rgyu lta bu yod/ me rlung la thim dus/ phyi rtags la lus drod che zhing rlangs pa dpag tu med pa 'byung*/ nang rtags su me khyer lta bu/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim dus/ lus yang zhing*/ nang rtags su mar me 'bar ba lta bu/ rnam shes sems la thim dus/ phyi rtags su zla ba shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags su/ pha las thob pa'i byang sems dkar po/ spyi bo nas snying khar 'ong*/ sems sems byung la thim dus/ phyi rtags nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags su ma las thob pa'i rak+ta dmar po/ lte ba na gnas pa de snying khar yongs nas/ thig le gnyis gcig tu 'dres/ sems byung ma rig pa la thim dus/ phyi rtags su mun pa chen po lta bu/ nang rtags su dran med du brgyal ba lta bu 'byung*/ 'di yi skabs su bdag chad kyi dogs pa'i 'jigs pa dpag tu med pa tha mal pa la 'byung*/ rnal 'byor pas/ phyi rtags dang nang rtags de rnams sngar bsgoms pa ltar byas nas ngo shes par byed/ gzhan yang*/ sems sems byung ma rig pa gsum po de dang*/ snang mched thob gsum dang*/ kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum dang*/ nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan gsum la sogs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs mang po 'dug na 'ang*/ snang mched thob gsum po de/ dpal gsang 'dus ltar na/ snang ba'i ngo bo zla ba shar ba de'i 'khor du rtogs pa'i 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu/ de mched pa la thim dus/ kho rang gi ngo bo dang*/ 'khor gyi rtog pa rnams mi mngon par gyur/ mched pa'i ngo bo nyi ma shar ba lta bu/

de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i zhe sdang las mched pa'i rtog pa sum cu so gsum de ma rig pa la thim dus/ mched pa'i ngo bo dang de'i 'khor gyi rtog pa rnams mi mngon par gyur/ thob pa'i ngo bo ni/ mun nag lta bu de'i 'khor/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun rnams gcig tu gyur nas/ snying gi dbus hūm̐ yig gi rnam pa thig le'i rnam par yod de/ bde mchog las kyang*/ thig le gcig la 'gyur med lnga// zhes pa'i don/ hūm̐ yig de nyid ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid du gnas pa yin no// nyer thob de nam mkha' sprin dwangs pa bzhin du yal nas song ba'i tshe na/ thams cad stong pa'i rmad po che// gsal zhing dwangs pa'i ye shes che// zhes gsang 'dus las gsungs pa'i don dang mthun par/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku de 'char ba yin/ 'di 'chi ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes kyang bya/ 'chi ba don dam pa'i bden pa zhes kyang bya/ stong pa chen po zhes kyang bya/ gzhan stong zab mo zhes kyang bya/ phyag rgya chen po zhes kyang bya/ 'di 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gzhi ma yin te/ ma rtogs pa la brten nas 'khor ba'i yal ga byung*/ rtogs pa la brten nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i yal ga byung ba yin te/ do ha las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las kyang*/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can te// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pa yin// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa yin// zhes dang*/ yang rje nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus las kyang*/ e ma ho/ sems nyid dri ma dang bcas pa'i// rnam 'phrul 'gro ba drug la sogs// nam mkha' mtha' klas khyab par snang*// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ rang rig spros bral 'di nyid ni// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa yin// rdo rje sems pa'ang 'di nyid yin// zhes pa'i don rnams 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku de/

dper na shel rang gi ngo bo la 'gyur ba med na'ang*/ rkyen gang dang phrad na/ rkyen de'i dbang du 'gro/ dpe de bzhin du/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku de ngo bo la 'gyur ba med pa ni/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ kho bo ni snang stong gang gis kyang phyogs su ma lhung ba'i rig pa gcer bu dri ma med pa 'di la phyag rgya chen po zhes pa'i mdzu gu 'dzugs/ zhes pa'i don no// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku 'di gzhi phyag rgya chen po yang yin/ lam phyag rgya chen po'ang yin/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po'ang yin no// de ltar du go dgos pa yin te/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang*/ du ma ro gcig rtogs na mkhas pa yin no bu// zhes dang*/ rig pa gcer bu dri ma med pa 'di'i steng du chos thams cad grub pa ltar 'ong bar 'dug mi gcig po'i chos gcig po// chos gcig po'i go chod po zhes pa'i don du 'dug 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku de la/ rnal 'byor pa sngar goms pa klong du gyur pa'i dbang gis/ rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa yin te/ lo tsā ba rin bzang gis/ bdag gi lus ni dgon pa'i gnas su bzhag /sems kyang de bzhin chos kyi dbyings su thim// grogs mchog rnams kyang de bzhin mdzad par zhu// zhes pa'i don du 'dug 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku de'i ngang nas/ rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pas bar do longs skur ldang ba yin la/ de'i ring rgyu ni/ rje mi las gsung ltar bskyed rim yin la/ nye rgyu ni sngar gyi snang mched thob gsum po de/ rang rang gi rnam shes rlung gi bzhon pa dang bcas pa/ g.yo med du 'chi ba 'od gsal la thim/ 'chi ba 'od gsal des snang mched thob gsum po de re zhig mi mngon par byas kyang*/ nyer thob kyi bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung phra mo de 'gyur/ de rags su song bas mched pa mngon par gyur/ de rags su gyur pas snang ba zla ba shar ba lta bu yin la/

'di gsum gyi ngo bo bar do longs skur ldang ba yin te/ gsang 'dus rim lnga las/ rnam shes gsum po slar yang ni// rnal 'byor pa yi lus su 'byung*// sgyu ma'i lus zhes de la bya// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// khyab pa chu yi zla ba bzhin// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris la// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// zhes pa 'di rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa klong du gyur pas bar do ldang tshul lo// tha mal pa rnams la sngar bshad pa ltar nyer thob kyi mthar 'chi ba 'od gsal cung zad tsam 'char la/ de las nyer thob ldang*/ de gti mug yin/ de rags su song bas mched pa 'byung*/ de zhe sdang yin/ de rags su song bas/ snang ba 'byung*/ de 'dod chags yin/ de gsum pos yul so sor longs spyad pas/ 'khor bar 'khyam par byed de/ mngon pa mdzod las/ sngon byung srid pa'i sha tshugs can// dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu// rigs mthun lha mig dag pas mthong*// zhes pa'i don no// bar do de sbyong bar byed pa la/ da ltar gyi dus su mnyam gzhag rjes thob nyin mo mtshan mo// mdor na bza' btung la sogs pa'i dus thams cad bar do yin par de yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ dran pas ma yengs par byed do// de ltar byas na bar do 'byongs par 'gyur te/ rje ras chung pas/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// mnyam pa nyid du bsgoms bsgoms nas// bar do'i 'jigs pa dor nas thal// bar do ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// ces dang*/ yang 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor gyi bya rgyu med// ces pa'i don du 'dug bsam gtan gyi 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras su gnyis yin te/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ mngon par shes pa lnga 'char zhing*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu rnam shes kyi khams la sogs pa drug

bsam gtan la sogs pa drug gis sbyangs pas/ mi bskyod pa dang*/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs drug 'thob pa yin te/ dus 'khor las kyang*/ mngon par shes pa lnga ni 'thob par 'gyur te mi yi bdag po bsam gtan sbyor bas dag pa'o// zhes gsungs/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa gsung rdo rje'i yan lag bar du dge ba'i khrid yig la/ srog dbu mar ma zhugs pa zhugs par byed pa srog rtsol/ zhugs pa brtan par byed pa 'dzin pa dang gnyis las/ dang po srog dbu mar ma tshud pa tshud par byed pa srog rtsol gyi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ 'bras bu dang gsum mo// srog rtsol gyi ngo bo ni/ ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar 'jug pa yin te/ dus 'khor las/ srog rtsol gyi ni lam gnyis po dag sgyil zhing dbu mar srog ni zhugs pa dag tu 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// srog rtsol gyi dbye ba la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa lam sbyang ba/ 'jam rlung dgang gtong gi sbyor bas srog dbu mar gzhug pa/ rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor bas/ srog dbu ma'i thig le bcing ba/ ma tshud cing ma chings na/ drag rlung btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam bkag pa/ lce chung skyod pa'i sbyor bas bdud rtsi myong ba/ de la brten pa'i 'pho ba dang drug go// rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa lam sbyang ba ni/ yul dang*/ gnas dang*/ dus dang*/ ji ltar sbyang ba'i tshul dang bzhi las/ yul ni/ rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas tshul gyi rtsa'i bshad pa cung zad byas na/ rtsa rgyas par phye na/ rtsa bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi ba spu'i grangs dang mnyam pa/ ring ba 'dom gang ma ni rgyu ma lta bu dang*/ thung ba sor gang yan chad do// de bsdu na/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ de'ang bsdu na/ rtsa 'khor lo che ba bco brgyad/ chung ba drug cu rtsa gsum/ de yang tshur bsdu na/ rtsa gsum du 'dus te/ brtag gnyis las/ rkyang ma shes rab rang bzhin te// thabs kyi ro ma yang dag gnas// kun 'dar ma ni dbus gnas su// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// zhes dang*/

rgyud las/ srog pa rtsa yi dbus na gnas// mdun na ma yin rgyab na min// sum cu rtsa gnyis mdud dang ldan// phra bas phra ba yang dag gnas// zhes pa'i don no// yang rtsa gsum po/ g.yon rkyang ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab ma dang gsum mo// g.yas su ro ma dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ gnyid ma dang gsum mo// dbus su kun 'dar ma dang*/ dbus ma dang*/ mun pa 'bab pa dang gsum mo// de gsum gyi kha dog ni/ g.yon dkar mo// g.yas dmar po// dbus sngon po/ lte ba yan chad du rtsa'i kha dog dang grangs dang*/ ming gi rnam grangs de lta bur gnas/ de man chad du/ dung can ma dang*/ bshang ba dang*/ gci ba'i rtsa gsum po gsang gnas kyi bar du/ dbus su dung can ma/ g.yon du gci ba 'bab pa/ g.yas su bshang ba 'bab pa/ gsang gnas nas nor bu'i bar du/ dbus su gci ba yin/ g.yon du dung can ma dang*/ g.yas su gci ba 'bab pa dang gsum mo// dung can ma'i kha dog ni ljang khu'o// rtsa 'khor rnams ni/ gsang gnas su rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis kha dog ljang khu/ lte bar rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi kha dog ser po/ snying kha rtsa 'dab ma brgyad kha dog nag po/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis kha dog dmar po/ dpral bar rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug kha dog dkar po/ spyi gtsug tu rtsa 'dab ma bzhi/ rdo rje nor bu la rked par rtsa 'dab ma brgyad/ rtser bzhi/ lag pa g.yas la rtsa 'khor che ba gsum/ rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gcig re/ sor mo lnga la rtsa 'dab ma bdun re/ rtsa 'khor bcu bzhi'o// de bzhin du lag pa g.yon pa/ rkang pa gnyis rnams shes par byas nas bsgom dgos pa yin te/ dus zhabs pas/ srog rtsol yul ni rtsa dang rlung*// zhes pa'i don no// yang rdo rje snying 'grel las/ gsang gnas nas ni lte ba'i bar// lam gsum byas nas 'gro ba dang*// lte ba nas ni snying kha'i bar// lam gsum byas nas 'gro ba dang*// snying kha nas ni mgrin pa'i bar// lam gsum byas nas 'gro ba dang*// mgrin pa nas ni dpral ba'i bar// lam gsum byas nas 'gro ba dang*// zhes pa'i don no// srog rtsol sgom pa'i gnas ni/

sngar dang 'dra/ dus ni sor bsam gnyis kyi skabs su/ stong gzugs mngon du gyur pa de rgyun mi 'chad du sgom dgos pa yin te/ rgyud las/ gzugs mthong de yi 'og tu ni// rgyun mi 'chad par srog rtsol bsgom// zhes pa'i don no// dus ni ji tsam bar du sgom na/ zla ba drug tu rgyun mi 'chad du bsgom ste/ brtag gnyis las/ zla drug bsgoms pa'i sbyor ba yis// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// 'di la 'khrul par mi bya ste// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab// ces dang*/ srog rtsol sgom pa'i tshul ni/ spyir srog rtsol gyi go rgyu ni/ lam 'bras ltar na/ sna bug g.yon nas rlung rgyu ba'i dus srog yin la/ g.yas su rgyu dus rtsol ba yin zer/ gsang 'dus ltar na/ rlung nang du rgyu ba srog phyi ru rgyu ba rtsol ba yin zer/ dus 'khor lugs la/ gyen rgyu dang thur ser gnyis srog rtsol dang*/ yang ro rkyang du rlung rgyu dus rtsol ba dang*/ dbu ma'i nang du rlung rgyu dus srog tu bzhed pa yin/ 'dir phyi ma ltar byas nas/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed tshul ni/ rlung gi kha dog la dmigs pa 'dzin tshul dang*/ yi ge la dmigs pa 'dzin tshul dang*/ rlung kho rang la dmigs pa 'dzin tshul dang gsum mo// rlung gi kha dog la dmigs pa 'dzin tshul ni/ sna bug g.yon du rlung kha dog dkar po ste/ nang du 'jug dus sku rdo rje/ lte bar gnas dus thugs rdo rje/ phyir gtong dus gsung rdo rje'o// de bzhin du g.yas dmar po// dbus ljang khur byas nas/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum po de/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed/ yi ge la dmigs pa ni/ sna bug g.yon gyi rlung gi kha dog dkar po de/ yi ge oṃ du dmigs nas yi ge dang*/ rlung dang*/ sems gsum po dbyer med du byas nas/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ sku rdo rje gnas pa'i tshe thugs rdo rje hūm̐ dkar por gyur/

ldang ba'i tshe na gsung rdo rje āḥdakar por ldang bar byed/ g.yas dang dbus gnyis yi ge'i kha dog mi gcig tsam man gong dang mtshungs/ rlung rang la dmigs pa ni/ rlung nang du song*/ nang du gnas/ phyir song bsam pa yang dang yang du dmigs pa gtad/ spyir rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bzhi yod de/ gsang 'dus las/ brjod pa dang ni dmigs pa dang*/ sgra bsgyur dang ni don dam mo// zhes gsungs pas 'dir brjod pa'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa mi byed la/ phyi ma gsum po byed pa yin no// de'i don ni 'bum las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rlung nang du gnas dus nang du gnas so zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so// rlung phyi rol du rgyu dus phyi rol tu rgyu'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so// de bzhin du rlung nang du ring du gnas pa dang*/ phyi rol tu ring du rgyu ba dang*/ nang du thung ngur gnas pa dang*/ phyi rol du thung ngur rgyu ba'o// zhes pa'i don ni gong gi rigs 'dres nas shes par byed dgos gsung*/ de ltar rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed pa de yang*/ rgyud las/ yul na rtsa dang rlung dang ni// zhes pas/ rtsa'i gnas tshul rags pa bshad zin/ rlung gi gnas tshul la/ skyes bu khams snyom pa nad med pa'i dbang du byas na/ da nangs lag pa'i ba spu mthong ba nas/ sang nangs par ba spu mthong ba'i bar gyi nyin zhag cha gcig la/ las rlung nyi khri chig stong rgyu/ dbu ma'i ngo skal drug brgya dang bdun cu rtsa lnga rgyu/ de yang lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dbang du byas na rtsa 'khor la/ 'pho chen bcu gnyis de yang dbu ma'i ngo skal la nga drug bzhi cha rgyu/ 'pho chen re re la 'pho chung lnga lngar rtsis pa'i dbu ma'i ngo skal la rlung bcu gcig bzhi cha rgyu/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel la spyod na/ dbugs rgyu ba rab 'bring tha gsum las/

rab sum cu/ 'bring sum cu so gnyis/ tha ma la sum cu rtsa phyed dang gsum/ 'dir 'bring po'i dbang du byas nas/ dbugs kyi 'gro ba'ang sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ chu srang gcig de sum cu so gnyis la chu tshod gcig de drug cu la zhag gcig de sum cu la zla ba gcig zla ba phyed gsum la zhag gcig lhag zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig lo phyed gsum la zla lhag gcig de ltar du lo phyed gsum la zla ba lhag re snon pas lo lhag gcig de bzhin du lo gsum phyogs gsum kyang shes par byed dgos/ lung ni mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed// lus can kun gyi srog gyur pa// 'di ni rnam shes bzhon pa ste// lnga yi bdag nyid bcu ming can// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni// shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur pa// dbang po'i lam las byung nas ni// yul rnams la ni spyod par byed// ces gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang*/ yan lag gi rlung lnga dang bcu dbang bsdu bar byed la/ de yang rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni/ thur sel mnyam gnas gyen rgyu srog 'dzin khyab byed yin/ yan lag gi rlung lnga ni/ rlung rus sbal/ rtsang pa/ nor las rgyal/ lha sbyin/ gzhu las rgyal lo// rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i gnas tshul ni/ thur sel 'doms la gnas/ mnyam gnas lte bar gnas/ gyen rgyu mgrin par gnas/ srog 'dzin snying kha na gnas/ khyab byed tshigs na gnas/ yan lag gi rlung rnams kyang yan lag so so la gnas/ rlung rgyu tshul ni g.yas nas bsdu rim gyis rgyu/ g.yon nas spro rim gyis rgyu/ de nas g.yas kyi rlung lnga rgyu tshul ni/ sa rlung smad la rgyu/ chu rlung sna'i ka ba bdar nas rgyu/ me rlung khur tshos ngos la rgyu/ rlung gi rlung steng du rgyu/ nam mkha'i rlung dbus su rgyu ba yin/ de bzhin du sna bug g.yon kyang shes dgos/ 'gog pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ sems spros pa med pa'i ngang du rlung g.yo med du gnas pa yin te/

'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom 'das// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung*// a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin// zhes dang*/ rgyud las kyang*/ rlung 'gags pa las sems kyang 'gags// gnyis kha 'gags pas gnyis med 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rje 'ba' rom pa chen pos kyang*/ gang zhig sems ni 'gags pa las// des ni rlung kyang 'gags par 'gyur// gang zhig rlung ni 'gags pa der// der ni sems kyang 'gags par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yang 'jug pa las/ sems 'gags pa de sku yi mngon sum mdzad// ces pa la sogs pa rnams kyi don rnams rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// 'jam rlung sgang gtong gi sbyor bas yon po sgyur ba ni/ rlung g.yas su rgyu ba'i dbang du byas na/ lag pa g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi g.yas pa'i nu ma btsir/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i rting pas rdo rje'i rtsa mnan rlung drag tu brngub/ lte 'og tu hril de mnan/ lus gnad rnams zhal las shes pa ltar du/ g.yon du rgyu dus kyang de bzhin bya/ rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor bas srog dbu ma'i thig ler 'ching ba'i lus gnad ni/ rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung ngam sems dpa'i dkyil krung gang bde byed/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis snying khar bsnol nas nu ma gnyis btsir/ rlung ro sangs te 'bud/ yang rlung drag tu rngub/ lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung drag tu then nas kha sbyor 'dzin/ mi thub tshad byung na rngub chung mchil ma'i rta dang bcas nas lte 'og tu gnon/ de nas gtong bar byed pa la sud tsam sud tsam byas nas gtong bar byed pa yin/ rlung 'jog khar rlung rngub chung byas te/ 'og tu rlung lhag 'dzin par byed/ 'di ma byas na rlung mi 'byongs pas/ man lung gu rus kyang gsungs par 'dug pas gnad shes pa gal che dgos pa 'dug 'dir rlung sbyor gsum po'i byed las ni/ yur bar chu 'dren par byed pa la/

sngon la yur ba 'chos pa dang 'dra ste/ yon po sgyur ba ni/ yur ba'i chu 'khyog tu mi 'jug pa dang 'dra/ bum pa can dngos gzhi ni/ yur ba'i nang du chu 'dren pa dang 'dra/ de yang snga ma ni sngon 'gro yin la/ phyi ma ni dngos gzhi yin pas/ phyi ma la gnad du bsnun dgos pa yin gsung*/ de'i bogs 'don ni/ ma chun cing ma chings na/ drag rlung btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam dgag tshul ni/ rang ngam gzhan kyang rung ste/ rlung drag tu brngubs nas/ rtsa chen gnyis kyi 'phar rtsa mthe bong dang srin lag gis drag tu gnon par byed pa rnams ni/ bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ de'i don yang brtag gnyis las/ longs spyod kyi ni rlabs gnyis la// rang gi g.yas dang lag gzhan gyis// mthe bong dang ni srin lag gang*// de ni rnal 'byor pa yis btsir// des ni ye shes skye bar 'gyur// de las ci zhig skye zhe na// gzhon nu'i bde ba ji lta 'am// lkug ma'i rmi lam ji lta'o// zhes pa'i don no// 'pho ba'i man ngag ni/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis las sbyang ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas/ bskyed rim bar gsal btab/ de'i ngang nas sems dkyil lam rdo rje dkyil krung gang bde byas nas/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab/ lus kyi dbus su/ rtsa dhū ti phra sbom rang gi blo tshod dang bstun pa'i lte ba phyin chad/ kha dog sngon po/ lte ba yan chad kha dog ljang khu/ de gnyis thabs shes yin gsungs/ rtsa dbu ma de'i yar sna spyi gtsug tu ham̐ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ lte ba phyin chad sor bzhi tsam du a dmar po zhig gsal btab/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po zhig gsal btab/ rang gi spyi bor khru gang tsam du/ seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan gyi gdan gyi steng du/ bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo 'am/ rdo rje 'chang 'od sgor dang bcas pa gsal gdab nas/ 'khor rnams kyang sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams gsal gdab/

de rjes rlung drag tu brngubs nas ham̐ dang mnyam du snying khar hūm̐ la bstim/ yang 'og rlung yar then nas a dmar po de snying kha'i hūm̐ la bstim/ de rjes hūm̐ spyi bo nas rgyang nge thon nas/ bla ma'i thugs kha la reg tsam bya/ yang hūm̐ mar byon nas ham̐ spyi bor bzhag hūm̐ dang a gnyis snying khar byon/ hūm̐ bsdad la lte bar a byon/ yang snga ma lte bar byed cing*/ las la sbyor ba ni gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba la steng rlung mar then/ 'og rlung yar then/ a ham̐ gnyis snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de nam mkha' la mda' 'phangs pa ltar du bla ma'i thugs khar rgyang nge 'phen/ de rjes mthe bong dang srin lag gnyis kyi longs spyod kyi nyi zla dgag par byas nas/ sems rtse gcig tu bla ma gtso 'khor la gtad nas spros med kyi ngang du 'jog par byed cing khyad par du rang gang mos kyi 'og min nam/ dga' ldan la sogs gnas gang 'dod du 'pho ba'i mdun pa drag tu byed pa yin pas/ 'di spros bcas kyi 'pho ba yin gsungs/ spros med kyi 'pho ba ni/ da ltar gyi shes pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po 'di/ lam dus su goms shing mngon du gyur pa la brten nas/ 'chi khar snang mched thob gsum gyi mthar/ thams cad stong pa'i ye shes spros med du 'char ba 'di spros pa med pa'i 'pho ba yin te/ kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor 'od gsal chos dbyings 'pho ba ni// 'pho ba'i man ngag kun gyi mchog yin no// zhes dang*/ yang sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ 'od gsal ba la rtag gnas pas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes dang*/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa la// sgom phyag rgya chen po mi zer ram// zhes pa'i don du 'dug yang rje mi la'i zhal nas/ rlung ni 'gro 'ong med na bde// 'gyu ba med na yongs kyi bde// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad kyis gsung ma grub pa 'grub par byed pa'i srog rtsol gyi ngo bo dbye ba dang bcas pa'o/

/'di dang phyi ma gsum gyi dag byed bsgoms pas thob pa'i 'bras bu rnams khrid yig ltar shes par bya/ grub pa brtan par byed pa 'dzin pa ni/ nang gi rtsa 'khor rnams kyi dbus su rlung sems gnyis su med pa'i thig le 'dzin par byed pa yin/ de yi tshul yang*/ lus gnad rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung byas la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol/ hūm̐ ring gcig gis rlung ro sangs te 'bud/ hūm̐ thung gcig gis nang du rngub/ lte 'og tu hril te skyur/ yang hūm̐ thung gis 'og rlung drag tu then/ lte ba dang*/ snying kha dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ gtsug gtor bar du thal te song*/ 'di yi skabs su/ lto ba sbyar lce rtse rkan mig gyen la zlog nas lta stangs kyis drag tu gcun/ spyi bo'i thig le de phaṭ kyis 'beb par byed/ 'di'i skabs su mig la sogs pa rnams thad du 'bebs/ 'di yid bzlas yin gyi ngag tu mi brjod/ de yang rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pa yi hūm̐ phaṭ bya/ zhes pa'i don du 'dug de yang 'dzin pa'i skabs su/ gtum mo'i me byang du rol pa'i stabs kyis gyen du drag tu bshig pa ni/ hūm̐ gi yar la drag tu bskyod pa'i don no// yang me de spyi bo'i ham̐ la reg nas/ ham̐ gi byang chub sems de spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar du phaṭ kyis 'bebs pa'i don yin te/ dus 'khor las/ spros byed nus pa'i gzugs can glog gi me dang mtshungs zhing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can// ye shes rdo rje snang ba mchog gi go 'phangs bgrod byed rnam par sbyang ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas// bdud rtsis 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo// de yang snga ma'i hūm̐ phaṭ sa la bsdad nas byed/ yang hūm̐ gi skyil ba dang*/

phaṭ kyi 'bebs pa snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ da lan rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsdams pa'i ngang nas langs nas/ hūm̐ drag gis skyil ba dang*/ phaṭ drag gis 'bebs pa sogs langs nas kyang byed pa yin gsung*/ des drag rlung gtum mo 'bar byed 'dzin pa ste bdud 'joms par byed pas so// de'i bogs 'don 'chi med bdud rtsi sgrub tshul ni/ lus gnad rdo rje dkyil krung la sogs pa sor sdud dang mtshungs/ khyab par spyi bor rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi sbubs su/ ā li bcu drug gsal gdab/ de'i dbus su ham̐ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba gsal gdab/ yid dmigs rlung gsum yig 'bru la gtad nas lce rkan la sbyar nas a ham̐ gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun ba thag ltar du/ lce thog tu bab nas btung bar byed/ mchil ma mid par byed/ rlung bar rlung 'dzin/ 'dis 'chi ba bslu bar byed pa yin te/ dus 'khor las/ bdud rtsis 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di thams cad hril gyis sgril na srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa gsung rdo rje nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag gsung rdo rje rnal 'byor bar du dge ba'i khrid yig rnams rdzogs so// ༈ //de yang rjes su dran pa grub pa'i yan lag dang*/ ting nge 'dzin grub pa chen po'i yan lag thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnams te/ tha mar dge ba'i khrid yig la rnam pa gnyis/ rjes su dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin no// rjes dran la/ rjes dran gyi ngo bo ni rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'am/ phyag rgya rjes su dran par byed pa yin la/ 'di'i tshul yang 'dzin pa'i skabs su/ gtum mo'i mes khams byang chub kyi sems rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su brtan par byas pa de/ phyag rgya rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil bar du byang sems kyi 'gengs par byed pa yin gsungs/ de la phyag rgya rjes su dran pa la/

dbang po rab kyi phyag rgya chen po/ 'bring ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ tha ma las rgya la brten nas khams byang chub kyi sems ci 'phel byed pa yin te/ dpal dus 'khor las/ las kyi phyag rgya yongs 'dor zhing*// ye shes phyag rgya spangs nas ni// phyag rgya che la rab tu sbyor// zhes dang*/ dri med 'od las/ 'dzag pa'i bde ba sbyin pa mo dang*/ mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba sbyin pa mo dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sbyin pa mo dang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ spyir phyag rgya gsum gyi dbye ba dang*/ khyad par du rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo de dbang po rab kyi phyag rgya mthar thug pa yin no// phyag rgya gsum po gang rung la brten nas/ lte bar gtum mo'i mes khams byang chub sems kyi dga' bzhi'i 'gros kyi nyams su len tshul ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo 'od sgor dang bcas pa/ rdo rje nor bu'i bu ga ham̐ gis bkag pa de'i rtse mor pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pas mtshan pa/ yum sna tshogs ma sku mdog gser ltar ser ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan par gsal ba'i gsang gnas su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la/ rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ dang bcas pas mtshan pa/ de ltar gsal gdab/ snyoms 'jug byas pas/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs pas dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying khar sleb pas mchog tu dga' ba/ snying kha nas lte ba'i bar du slebs pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtser slebs pas lhan cig skyes dga'/ de lta bu'i dga' ba bzhi po re re la'ang bzhi bzhi 'byed/ de'i tshul yang*/ dga' ba'i dga' ba/ dga' ba'i mchog dga'/ dga' ba'i dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ dga' ba'i lhan cig skyes dga'/ de bzhin du dga' ba 'og ma gsum la'ang re re la bzhi bzhi byas pa'i bcu drug yod pa yin te/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das// bsam gtan bzhi po'i rtse mo can// bsam gtan yan lag kun shes zhing*// zhes pa'i don no// de yang rdo rje nor bu'i rtser ma 'phos pa nas cha bco lngar 'byed/

'phos pas cha bcu drug tu 'byed/ bco lngar 'byed tshul ni/ zla ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang 'dra gsungs/ de thams cad kyi don hril gyis bsdus nas nyams su len tshul ni/ bskyed rim gsal btab nas/ spyi bo nas mgrin pa'i bar du khams byang chub sems de spyan 'dren/ de bzhin du mgrin pa nas snying kha'i bar du hūm̐ gis spyan drangs/ snying kha nas lte ba'i du bam̐ gyis spyan drangs/ lte ba nas gsang gnas bar du hoḥs spyan drangs/ de'i rjes su his lus thams cad khyab par byed/ yang khams byang chub kyi sems de nyid/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse nas lte ba'i bar du lis 'gugs/ lte ba nas snying kha'i bar du yus 'gugs/ snying kha nas mgrin pa'i bar du ris 'dren par byed/ mgrin pa nas spyi bo'i bar du is 'dren par byed/ de'i rjes su āḥzhes brjod pas/ lus thams cad la khyab par byed/ 'di yi rlung sbyor ni yar skyil ba mar 'bebs pa rnams 'dzin pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra gsungs/ 'dzin pa'i rjes su rjes dran 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir 'dzin pa zhes pa bde stong gnyis su med pa/ gsal stong gnyis su med pa/ rig stong gnyis su med pa/ thams cad kyi stong pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu de yin la/ des 'dzin pa'i go rgyu ni/ rang dang ngo bo dbyer med kyi khams byang chub kyi sems de 'dzin par byed/ de la dus rgyun ring du gnas na/ gzhan don rgyun 'chad pa'i nges par 'gyur bas na/ zhu ba glus bskul dgos/ zhes pa rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin te/ kyai rdo rje las/ rje btsun snying rjes yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// kyai rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' tshol 'jig rten 'gron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni ma 'tshal bas// rdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// bdag gi khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyi// mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig

/g.yung mo bdag ni dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces tshad med bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa lha mo bzhis/ thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal de las/ thabs bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa/ kyai rdo rje slong bar mdzad do// de bzhin du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'gog pa rdo rje'i sgrod sems las// mtshan ma nyer 'tsher lnga ru 'gyur// mtshan ma lnga ru gyur pa de// byang chub rdo rjes bshad pa yin// dang po smig rgyu lta bu ste// gnyis pa du ba lta bu'o// gsum pa srin bu me khyer te// bzhi pa mkha' nang mar me ste// lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni// sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o// zhes gsungs pa rnams thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal las gnas bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ phyag rgya rjes su dran par byed pa ni/ thabs bde ba chen po rgyas par byed pa'i don du 'dug des thugs ma grub pa 'grub par byed pa rjes su dran pa song*/ de brtan par byed pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ khams byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtser mi 'pho bar g.yo med du gnas pa de dang*/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid ni dbyer med du gnas pas/ dran pas g.yo med du 'dzin pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo yin la/ des gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'dab bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi phyed khengs pas las rlung stong dang brgyad 'gag mchog gi mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba brgya drug cu 'phel/ de bzhin du sa dang po rab tu dga' ba thob/ spang bya ma rig pa 'gag de bzhin du gsang gnas su/ 'khor lo phyed khengs pas las rlung 'gag pa dang*/ mchog gi mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba 'phel ba snga ma'i grangs dang 'dra la/ spang bya 'du byed 'gag pa dang*/ thob bya sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa thob pa dus mnyam/ de bzhin lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar du 'khor lo lnga dang*/ 'khor lo re re la sa gnyis gnyis thob pa/ gsum pa 'od gsal ba dang*/ bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba dang gnyis yin/

spang bya rnam shes dang*/ ming gzugs 'gag snying kha'i 'khor lo la/ sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba dang*/ drug pa mngon du gyur pa gnyis thob/ spang bya ma rig pa dang tshor ba gnyis 'gag mgrin pa'i 'khor lor sa bdun pa ring du song ba dang*/ brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang gnyis thob/ spang bya sred pa dang len pa gnyis 'gag dpral ba'i rtsa 'khor la/ sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros dang*/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin gnyis thob/ spang bya srid pa dang*/ skye ba gnyis 'gag gtsug gtor gyi 'khor lor sa bcu gcig kun tu 'od dang bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma can/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin rnams thob/ spang bya rga shi 'gag de yang 'jig rten pa rnams kyi khams byang chub sems thur du rgyug rak+ta dmar po gyen tu rgyug sangs rgyas rnams kyi de las bzlog pa yin te/ dus 'khor las/ 'jig rten pa rnams 'chi ba na// zla ba bdud rtsi thur du rgyug /steng du nyi ma rdul sgra gcan// sangs rgyas rnams kyi de las zlog /ces pa'i don no// de yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhabs dmar po g.yas pa brkyang ba ni/ rak+ta thur du song la/ dkar po g.yon pa bskums pa ni/ zla ba gyen du 'dren pa mtshon te/ mtshan brjod las/ rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon// rkang mtheb sen mo'i khyon gyis brkyang*// tshangs pa'i g.yul sa rtse nas gnon// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od// chags bral la sogs chags pa che// kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od// ces pa'i don du 'dug rnal 'byor yan lag drug po de mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mthar sna tshogs thig le chen po dang sems dbyer med du gyur pa yin te/ sha ba ri'i gzhung chung las/ sna tshogs thig le chen po la// re kha nag po'i ri mo 'byung*// de'i nang 'gro ba rigs drug dang*// shin tu phra ba'i sprul sku dang*// longs sku du ma 'byung bar 'gyur// de la sems ni thim pa na// rnal 'byor yan lag drug mthar phyin// de thams cad kyi sbyor ba yan lag drug po'i don tshang la ma nor ba bshad zin no// gong du bshad pa'i du ba la sogs pa'i nyams rtogs gang shar thams cad shin tu sbed pa gal che ste/

rgyud las/ du ba la sogs rnams kyi mtshan ma 'dzin pa dag kyang gang zhig 'di rnams gsang bar bya// zhes pa'i 'grel par/ du ba la sogs pa rnams kyi mtshan ma 'dzin pa ni/ a wa dhū ti'i sgo nas kyang gi sgras te bde ba de nyid la'o// 'di rnams thams cad gsang bar byas te/ byis pa'i skye bo rnams la sba bar bya'o// zhes dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyis kyang*/ de phyir bla ma dam pas gnang ba yi// lam zab rin po che 'di slob ma yis// chom rkun rtsa lag yongs su spangs byas te// 'bad pas shin tu legs par sba bar bya// zhes pa 'di phyogs tsam mtshon par byas pa yin gyi/ rgyas par khrid yig las shes par bya'o// bde chen 'gyur med dus kyi 'khor lo nas// mkhyen rab dbang phyug rat+na'i mtshan can bar// snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i zab don la// brjed pas 'jigs nas yig ger bkod pa la// chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bzod par gsol// 'di las byung ba'i dge ba cung zad des// mkhyen rab dbang phyug sku tshe brtan pa dang*// 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho las myur bsgral te// mthar thug dus kyi 'khor lo thob par shog /gzhan yang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// nges don mthar thug sbyor ba yan lag drug /ma nor tshul bzhin ston pa'i bla ma dang*// mjal zhing bka' brgyud bstan pa rin chen 'di// srog dang brdos nas phyogs bcur spel bar shog// /

ces pa 'di yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen grags pa rgya mtsho sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dben gnas khra ba kha'i ri khrod rtser/ chu mo glang gi lor/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dus chen/ dkar phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la/ bdag kun dga' rin chen gyis legs par gtan la phab/ myong ba thon nas bris pas dge ba des// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog// / //
